name: native scorekeeper chart load and judgment dispatch
lua_assertions:
local p1 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P1')
local p2 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P2')
local notes = '1100\n2000\n3000\n00L0'
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
assert(p1:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 20)
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 0)
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 0 and p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
assert(p2:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 0)
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 0, 'TapNoteScore_W2')
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 5 and p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 4)
assert(p1:GetCurrentCombo() == 2 and p1:GetTapNoteScores('TapNoteScore_W2') == 1)
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 48, 'TapNoteScore_Miss')
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 10 and p1:GetActualDancePoints() == -8)
assert(p1:GetCurrentCombo() == 0 and p1:GetTapNoteScores('TapNoteScore_Miss') == 1)
_ITG_SCORE_HOLD(0, 0, 48, 'HoldNoteScore_LetGo')
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 15 and p1:GetActualDancePoints() == -8)
assert(p1:GetHoldNoteScores('HoldNoteScore_LetGo') == 1)
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 144, 'TapNoteScore_W1')
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == p1:GetPossibleDancePoints())
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == -3 and p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
assert(not pcall(_ITG_SCORE_ROW, 0, 144, 'TapNoteScore_W1'))
assert(not pcall(_ITG_SCORE_HOLD, 0, 0, 48, 'HoldNoteScore_Held'))
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(1, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
for _,row in ipairs{0,48,144} do _ITG_SCORE_ROW(1, row, 'TapNoteScore_W1') end
_ITG_SCORE_HOLD(1, 0, 48, 'HoldNoteScore_Held')
assert(p2:GetActualDancePoints() == 20 and p2:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier01')
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == -3)
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
assert(p1:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 20 and p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 0)
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 0 and p1:GetTapNoteScores('TapNoteScore_Miss') == 0)
p1:FailPlayer()
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 0, 'TapNoteScore_W1')
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 0 and p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 5)
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Failed')
_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Stage', 'NoHolds', true)
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
assert(p1:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 20)
for _,row in ipairs{0,48,144} do _ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, row, 'TapNoteScore_W1') end
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 15 and p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 15)
assert(not pcall(_ITG_SCORE_HOLD, 0, 0, 48, 'HoldNoteScore_Held'))
_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Stage', 'NoHolds', false)
for _,mode in ipairs{'FA+','Casual'} do
    _ITG_SCORE_CONFIG(mode, true, false)
    _ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
    local weight = mode == 'Casual' and 3 or 5
    assert(p1:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 4*weight)
    _ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 0, 'TapNoteScore_W2')
    assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == weight)
    assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == (mode == 'Casual' and 2 or 5))
end
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', true, true)
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, '1000', 'Difficulty_Beginner')
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 0, 'TapNoteScore_Miss')
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 0 and p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 5)

_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', false, false)
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, notes, 'Difficulty_Challenge')
assert(p1:GetPossibleDancePoints() == 17)
_ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, 0, 'TapNoteScore_W1')
assert(p1:GetActualDancePoints() == 4 and p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 4)
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', true, false)
local jumps = {}
for i = 1, 126 do jumps[i] = '1100' end
_ITG_SCORE_CHART(0, table.concat(jumps, ',\n'), 'Difficulty_Challenge', 300)
for i = 0, 124 do _ITG_SCORE_ROW(0, i*192, 'TapNoteScore_W1') end
local ok, err = pcall(_ITG_SCORE_ROW, 0, 125*192, 'TapNoteScore_W1')
assert(not ok and err:find('native toasty screen is unavailable', 1, true))
assert(p1:GetCurrentPossibleDancePoints() == 630)
